description:
It was a midsummer day in June, and I was working as usual, dealing with the stress of my boss’s habitual outbursts.

A sudden status window appeared in front of me, and the word ‘Zombie’ caught my eye. But before I could process it, my boss’s shouting rang out again. I swallowed the urge to quit on the spot and forced myself to keep working.
That is… until the Ice Age suddenly arrived.

– Emergency Alert: Cold Wave Warning.

In an instant, eternal snow spread before my eyes, and my intern’s body twisted into something grotesque… a zombie.

‘What the hell is going on here?’
